nestedRepoPath.description: Project-relative path of the repository's top directory, without '.' or '..' segments.

envSetupPath.description: Project-relative file path. '../' may reach the git root when the project root is nested, and no further: a copy source outside the main checkout's git root, or a target outside the new worktree, is refused when the worktree is set up.

merge_request_requires_manual_approval.description: When true, merge requests require human approval before merge; CLI may print reminders.

require_implementation_review_before_fin.description: When true, finish-this-task requires a human-approved implementation review in registry.yaml and work/implementation-summary-<NODE_ID>.md before closing the task.

require_implementation_before_finish.description: When true (default if omitted), finish-this-task refuses to close a node whose branch changes no file under its declared touch_zones. Skipped when the node declares no zones, or when git cannot compute the diff. CLI --allow-empty-implementation overrides it per run.

cleanup_work_artifacts_on_finish.description: When true (default if omitted), finish-this-task removes work/brief-, work/prompt-, and work/implementation-summary- for the node after validate/export.

on_complete.description: How finish-this-task lands work: pr = open a PR/MR (default); merge = merge the feature branch into the integration branch and land it per land (push, the default, pushes; local fetches and pushes nothing); auto = try that merge first, then suggest PR/MR on failure.

land.description: How finish-this-task in merge (and auto) mode lands the root repository, as nested_repos' land does for nested ones: push (default) merges onto <remote>/<integration_branch> and pushes; local merges into the local integration_branch (bookkeeping resolved and land_check_cmd run as for push), fetching and pushing nothing, and says so. See docs/git-workflow-preferences.md.

pr_body_footer.description: Text finish-this-task appends to the PR/MR body it writes (work/pr-body-<NODE_ID>.md), such as an attribution line, with surrounding whitespace stripped. It must contain a non-whitespace character: an empty or whitespace-only value fails validation rather than meaning no footer. Omitted: the body is unchanged.

implementation_summary.description: Whether executor prompts say to commit work/implementation-summary-<NODE_ID>.md on the feature branch (commit, the default) or to leave it uncommitted for the review packet to read from the worktree (local). Prompts never tell workers to force-add an ignored path: when .gitignore ignores the summary, the prompts follow the ignore rule and validate says so.

track_worker_logs.description: Whether worker logs are tracked in git (default off when omitted). off (or YAML false) keeps them in gitignored work/.workers/ only; events also mirrors each worker's event log to work/worker-logs/<NODE_ID>/<worker id>.events.jsonl in the worker's checkout, which finish-this-task commits with the leaf; full mirrors the raw output log (<worker id>.log) too. Logs get long: full can add megabytes per leaf.

worker_sandbox.description: Whether unattended worker turns (worker delegate, message, resume) run their harness in a bubblewrap sandbox (default off when omitted: a project opts in). bwrap requires it: a host without bwrap, a turn outside a linked worktree, or a sandbox that fails to start stops the turn. auto uses bwrap on Linux where it is installed, with the same refusals, and elsewhere warns on each launch and runs unsandboxed. off (or YAML false) runs unsandboxed. See docs/orchestration-workers.md (Worker sandbox).

baseline_cmd.description: Shell command do-next-available-task and grind-session run on the integration branch, after syncing and before claiming a leaf (e.g. make test). A non-zero exit refuses the pickup, so a red base is fixed before a leaf inherits it. CLI --baseline-cmd wins (an empty value turns it off for that run); --baseline-warn downgrades a failure to a warning.

land_check_cmd.description: Shell command finish-this-task runs in merge (and auto) mode on the local merge commit, at the project root of a detached temporary worktree, before it pushes the integration branch (e.g. the full test and lint gate). A non-zero exit pushes nothing and resets the local integration branch. CLI --land-check-cmd wins (an empty value skips it for that run). pr mode never runs it.

verify_cmd.description: Command executor briefs and reviewer prompts give for running the leaf's tests, with the test paths appended (e.g. python -m pytest -n 4 -p no:cacheprovider). Keep its worker count small: several workers on one machine each running a full parallel suite oversubscribe the CPU. Separate from land_check_cmd, which runs the full suite at landing. When omitted, the prompts say to cap parallel test workers when other workers share the machine.

prefer_agentic_pick_order.description: When true, do-next-available-task and grind-session order each pickup tier (Blocked, MR-rejected, the rest) Agentic-led, then Mixed, then unset, then Human-led, outline order within each (default false: outline order only). Eligibility is unchanged. CLI --prefer-agentic / --no-prefer-agentic wins.

grind_session_max_limit_waits.description: grind-session: how many times one leaf may wait out a Claude usage limit before the run stops (default 3). CLI --max-limit-waits wins.

grind_session_max_limit_wait_hours.description: grind-session: longest single wait for a stated Claude reset, in hours (default 6). A reset further out stops the run rather than waiting unattended. CLI --max-limit-wait-hours wins.

grind_session_limit_wait_grace_seconds.description: grind-session: slack added after the stated reset, because clocks disagree (default 120). CLI --limit-wait-grace-seconds wins.

nested_repos.description: Separately versioned git repositories under the project root, each a project-relative path or {path, integration_branch, remote, land, base, refuse_behind_remote} (integration_branch and remote default to this file's; land push, base remote). worker delegate and do-next-available-task --worktree give each one a worktree at the same path inside the leaf's worktree: on the leaf's branch when the leaf's touch zones cover it, detached at its integration tip otherwise. worker reconcile diffs them, finish-this-task in merge (and auto) mode lands each leaf branch (per land) before the main repository, and review-packet includes their diffs. See docs/git-workflow.md.

integration_branch.description: This repository's integration branch (default: integration_branch above).

land.description: How finish-this-task (merge and auto mode) lands the leaf's branch here before the main repository: push (default) merges onto <remote>/<integration_branch> and pushes; local merges onto the local integration_branch and moves only that ref (only if it has not moved meanwhile), pushing nothing; manual lands nothing and stops finish before the main repository, printing the git merge command to run here, then re-run finish-this-task.

base.description: Which integration tip this repository's leaf worktrees start from (and diffs are taken against): remote (default) is <remote>/<integration_branch>, else the local branch; local is the local integration_branch, so local-only commits are included.

refuse_behind_remote.description: With base: local, refuse to create a worktree while the local integration_branch is behind its remote-tracking branch (default false: use it anyway).

env_setup.description: What a new leaf worktree gets when do-next-available-task --worktree or worker delegate creates it: copy names files (usually ignored, so git does not bring them) copied from the main checkout's project root, link names paths symlinked from it, then cmd runs at the worktree's project root. A failure stops the pickup or launch with the command's output. doctor runs cmd in the main checkout. See docs/git-workflow.md.

cmd.description: Shell command run at the new worktree's project root after the copies (e.g. uv sync --all-packages --all-groups --locked).

copy.description: Files copied from the main checkout before cmd runs: a path (copied to the same path) or {from, to} (e.g. .env.example to .env).

link.description: Paths symlinked from the main checkout into the new worktree at the same project-relative path, before cmd runs (e.g. node_modules, .venv). Each is added to .git/info/exclude so a directory-only ignore pattern (node_modules/) does not leave the symlink untracked. See docs/orchestration-worktrees.md.

grind_session_max_empty_retries.description: grind-session: how many times to re-run a Claude implement command that died on a signal without printing anything (default 2). Not a retry for failed implementations - those still stop the run. CLI --max-empty-retries wins.

shared_zones.description: Directory touch zones that do not make two leaves overlap in grind-session --plan batches or the validate registry overlap warning (default ["planning/", "shared/"]; [] turns it off). Two leaves naming the same file under one still overlap.
